'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Roy McCarthy DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Roy McCarthy]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Username:''' RybackStun
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
